newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-JOUBERT RECALLED TO SPRINGBOK TEAM.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-JOUBERT RECALLED TO SPRINGBOK TEAM.

text.p: Natal fullback Andre Joubert has been recalled to the Springbok team for the Tri-Nations test against Australia in Pretoria on Saturday.
Joubert replaces Russell Bennett who had to withdraw with a stress fracture of the ankle.
There has also been a late change in the pack where Northern Transvaal lock Krynauw Otto makes way for Western Province's Fritz van Heerden. Otto failed a fitness test on Tuesday.
Van Heerden is replaced on the bench by Transvaal lock Hannes Strydom.
